Independent reading notes on the actual complete PermWorld tables
Status: only PermWorld is complete; Graph is not included in these notes yet.
This round reads existing CSV/JSON/reports only, without arrays, model construction, training, new similarities, or statistical significance calculations.
32 conditions,16 encoding groups,64 sources,and8 relations share one world and specified initialization; all counts are dependent descriptive units, not independent repetitions.
Original S is not the raw control; read six S values→Bt→B0/dc/dw/Delta. Positive Delta does not require increased correct S.

1. Primary answer-stratified final ordinary CKA: all six original S values are retained; Bt has 26 positive/6 negative cells. B0 direction is strongly associated with encoding and transformation type; Delta has 18 positive/14 negative cells. These are dependent descriptive cells, not 32 independent repetitions.
2. All 16 encoding groups have B0 direction reversals accompanying Gamma0. Delta reverses in 14 groups and Bt in six: five reverse both, nine only Delta, one only Bt, and one neither. A Delta reversal alone is not a reversal of trained relation preference.
3. In 16 of 18 positive-Delta cells, the fall in wrong-pair similarity exceeds the positive rise in correct-pair similarity (compare -dw with max(dc,0)). This is a component description, not decomposition of similarity sources or causal mechanisms.
4. Under answer control, the three metrics agree on Bt direction in 32/32 cells and Delta in 30/32. The two Delta disagreements are one-line GRU peaks/valleys and runs: k10 is slightly negative while CKA and Procrustes are positive. Under raw controls, agreement is 31/32 for Bt and 24/32 for Delta. Raw ordinary CKA has 25 positive Delta cells, versus 18 after answer control.
5. Ordinary and U-centered final CKA agree on Bt/Delta directions in all 32 cells; this does not mean correct/wrong component changes or all layers are insensitive.
6. All 18 positive primary ordinary-CKA Delta cells are positive at all 21 lengths. Of 14 negative cells, 13 are negative at every length; one-line GRU LIS/LDS has three positive and 18 negative lengths. Bt is consistent across lengths in 24/32 cells and mixed in eight; aggregate means must not conceal length exceptions.
7. Trained positive-Bt counts increase from 18/32 at layer 1 to 26/32 at layer 4/normalization, but layerwise Delta is also strongly affected by B0. One-line TF descents/inverse-descents block1 to 2: B0 -0.064780→-0.595885, Bt 0.093002→0.104759, Delta0.157781→0.700644. The Delta jump cannot primarily be described as a large Bt increase.
8. For both inversion relations in one-line GRU, early-layer Bt is negative and final-layer Bt positive while Delta stays positive throughout: descents/inverse-descents layer1 Bt-0.299907, Delta+0.476784, final Bt+0.067502, Delta+0.684425; exceedances/deficiencies layer1 Bt-0.396773, Delta+0.385510, final Bt+0.045478, Delta+0.668512.
9. The original four cycle-encoded tasks are weaker, but this does not characterize all 16 tasks. Cycle GRU exceedances/deficiencies both reach 100% analysis accuracy, fixed points 100%, and components 99.991%; the associated inversion Delta still reverses while Bt remains positive. Encoding effects are not confined to earlier weak tasks. This does not identify an encoding causal mechanism or equivalence at equal mastery.
10. All 64 sources remain included. Among 16 sources per configuration, two cycle TF and one cycle GRU source do not exceed training-defined length modes; all sources in other groups do. Above-mode does not mean sufficient learning. Anti-fixed points, LIS/LDS, and cycle runs still show substantial mastery differences.
11. Among 32 same-task cross-configuration pairs, raw ordinary CKA changes are 23 positive/9 negative, answer-controlled changes nine positive/23 negative, and U-centered answer-controlled changes ten positive/22 negative. Different answer keys and shared inputs preclude interpreting this as a shared algorithm. One-line descents raw CKA changes 0.256389→0.865657 while answer-controlled CKA changes 0.258252→0.200323.
12. There are 1704 undefined components: 1536 structurally constant embedding components across two CKA versions and 168 output-Procrustes components blank under prespecified rank/energy rules. All three primary final-hidden metrics are fully defined. Blank is not zero, and missing components are not reweighted.
13. Output probabilities retain strongly encoding-dependent initialization/increments: answer-controlled output Delta has 16 positive/16 negative cells and Bt29 positive/3 negative cells. Hidden Delta minus output Delta cannot calculate an additional mathematical mechanism.
14. All answer-stratified static true-label baselines are undefined because of structural constancy after removing group means, not because the baselines have no mathematical relations. Original one-hot/scalar/output definitions and primary hidden states must be reported separately.
15. The five Perm task phases and readouts have passed; Root is still executing Graph separately. These notes do not declare Graph or the whole scientific scope complete. No training, new metrics, p-values, significance, equivalence, or universal causal claims.
